column3: Close to the Hebrew; קֹהֶלֶת (“Qoheleth, the Assembler”) is rendered “the Preacher.”
Close to the Hebrew; הֲבֵל הֲבָלִים (“breath of breaths”) is rendered “Vanity of vanities,” and “Qoheleth” “the Preacher.”
Close to the Hebrew; שׁוֹאֵף (“panting”) is rendered “hastens.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to the place where the rivers go” is rendered “To the place from which the rivers come.”
Close to the Hebrew; “all things are wearisome” is rendered “All things are full of labor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Qoheleth” is rendered “the Preacher.”
Close to the Hebrew; “an evil task” is rendered “this burdensome task,” and “to be busy with” “by which they may be exercised.”
Close to the Hebrew; “futility and striving of wind” is rendered “vanity and grasping for the wind.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I have spoken with my heart” is rendered “I communed with my heart.”
Close to the Hebrew; “striving of wind” is rendered “grasping for the wind.”
Close to the Hebrew; כָּעַס (“vexation”) is rendered “grief.”
